Place review

Hadleigh Country Park

A genuine visit to learn about hiring bikes and using the trails, with walking paths, trim trails, play areas and views over the Thames Estuary.

Hadleigh, Benfleet

Genuine visit description

We went primarily to learn about hiring bikes and using the trails which were created for the mountain biking events at the London 2012 Olympics. But there is so much more, with great paths for walking, trim trails, play areas, including for remote controls, not to mention the ruins of the 13th century which dominated the stunning landscape over the Thames Estuary.

Visiting advice

Good walking shoes and a sun hat and cream, as there are lots of open spaces.

Access review

What might help visitors plan.

Being an area for mountain biking, the terrain was quite hilly so may not be suitable for everyone. However, there were benches and seats strategically placed throughout the walking areas. The cycling trails are quite stony, hence the need for good walking shoes. However, you can mostly walk on grass or grassy paths.

A production guide would present this as a dated first-hand observation and link to approved official information where needed.
